camel_example: aliyun agentidentity CreateTokenVault --region cn-hangzhou --TokenVaultName default --version 2025-09-01 --method POST --force
name: CreateTokenVault

parameters.help_en: The name of the token vault. The name must be unique within the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 凭证库的名称，在当前阿里云账号下唯一
parameters.name: token_vault_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the token vault
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the Resource Access Management (RAM) role used to authorize the AgentIdentity service to access other cloud resources such as KMS
parameters.help_zh: 用于授权 AgentIdentity 服务访问 KMS 等其他云资源的 RAM 角色 ARN
parameters.name: role_arn

parameters.help_en: The encryption configuration of the token vault. The value is a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 凭证库加密配置，JSON 字符串
parameters.name: encryption_config

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request

TokenVault.description_en: The details of the token vault

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the token vault was created, in UTC ISO 8601 format
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，UTC ISO 8601 格式

Description.description_en: The description of the token vault

EncryptionConfig.description_en: The encryption configuration of the token vault

KeyType.description_en:
The type of the encryption key. Valid values:
SERVICE_MANAGED_KEY: service-managed key
CUSTOMER_MANAGED_KEY: customer-managed KMS key
KeyType.description_zh: 加密密钥类型。取值：SERVICE_MANAGED_KEY（服务托管密钥）、CUSTOMER_MANAGED_KEY（用户自管 KMS 密钥）

KmsKeyArn.description_en: The ARN of the KMS key used when KeyType is set to CUSTOMER_MANAGED_KEY
KmsKeyArn.description_zh: 当 KeyType 为 CUSTOMER_MANAGED_KEY 时所使用的 KMS 密钥 ARN

RoleArn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the Resource Access Management (RAM) role used to authorize the AgentIdentity service to access other cloud resources such as KMS
RoleArn.description_zh: 用于授权 AgentIdentity 服务访问 KMS 等其他云资源的 RAM 角色 ARN

TokenVaultArn.description_en: The ARN of the token vault

TokenVaultName.description_en: The name of the token vault. The name must be unique within the current Alibaba Cloud account
TokenVaultName.description_zh: 凭证库的名称，在当前阿里云账号下唯一
